subject_session: sub-Jenkins MC_Maze (primary); replication in DANDI:000129 MC_RTT, sub-Indy

headline_stat.name: velocity (2D-spline) vs direction-only Poisson GLM median pseudo-R^2 over tuned units
headline_stat.value: 0.040 vs 0.020 (96% of tuned units favor velocity)

stated_limitation: The GLMs model instantaneous kinematics only and include no spike-history term, so a unit's own refractoriness and bursting are unmodelled. Direction sampling in MC_Maze is uneven, which leaves two of twelve 30 deg bins too sparse to use... Single-unit R2 values on 50 ms Poisson counts are small in absolute terms throughout... Most importantly, all of this is correlational. Tuning to velocity here is a statement about what firing rate predicts, not a claim that velocity is the variable the cortex explicitly represents.

justification.dataset: Uses the canonical MC_Maze reach dataset (000128, Jenkins) and independently replicates in MC_RTT (000129, Indy), exactly the standard choice for reach direction/velocity tuning.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile with disk cache, straight successful trials selected, reach direction measured from the hand, movement-onset alignment verified inside observed epochs, and the electrode/area mapping problem is diagnosed and handled honestly.
justification.analysis: Cosine fits with permutation tests, circular statistics for PD comparison, cross-validated nested Poisson GLMs, lag scans, ridge decoding, population vector, and circular-shift permutation controls are all appropriate and correctly applied.
justification.correctness: Every headline number I checked reproduces from the committed result files and figures and is internally consistent, with the one 0.55-vs-0.41 decode figure explicitly distinguished as during-movement vs overall peak.
justification.figures: Publication-quality figures with labeled units, sample sizes, clear population summaries, and example units chosen by modulation depth (the effect itself), making the velocity-scaling claim visible.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate, two negative/weak results are reported rather than smoothed over, a data-provenance caveat is flagged, and a full limitations section names the specific weaknesses of this result.
